claims.statement: AstaPS EntityAiKillSelfNotify=29500 is not a confirmed 7.1 opcode: CmdId 29500 is absent from all 4896 unique entries of the exact published 7.1 client registry.

The historical drowning-request opcode 20113 cannot be assigned to 7.1 SceneEntityDrownReq without native proof: exact 7.1 numeric/type identity is 20113=NHHIOCJPICK (type 60907, two declared metadata fields), while AstaPS calls 20113 GadgetTalkChangeNotify.
Current 7.1 registry numeric identity 26715=NILBKHGJOMB (type 14990, two declared metadata fields) is established; this does not identify it as SceneEntityDrownRsp.

The pinned community LunaGC 7.1 PacketOpcodes mapping explicitly uses negative sentinels (-22, -97, -150) for the three old drowning/AI packet names, which are placeholders rather than recovered 7.1 opcodes.
No live monster-water packet transaction or sample-bound native sender/handler trace has yet proven the current 7.1 drowning message, CmdId, wire entity-id field or response semantics.
